newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia, Germany to strengthen business ties.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia, Germany to strengthen business ties.

text.p: Indonesian and German businessmen held a one-day seminar in Jakarta on Saturday to discuss future trade, an Indonesian government official said.
"This forum should lay the groundwork for cooperation into the next century," he said.

Indonesia's Research and Technology Minister Jusuf Habibie, who was educated in Germany and has close ties with it, and German Economics Minister Guenther Rexrodt opened the forum, which focused on seven business sectors.
The forum preceded the arrival on Saturday of German Chancellor Helmut Kohl, who will spend a leisurely day with President Suharto on Sunday before the official part of his visit on Monday.
Saturday's meeting covered energy production and distribution, the automotive industry, oil and gas, steel, trade and services, banking and investments and human resources.
Government officials said memoranda of understanding would be signed on Monday.
